G2 has acquired Capterra for an undisclosed amount, bringing together two prominent platforms in the business software discovery and review market. Capterra is widely recognized as a leading destination for organizations seeking the right software and services, offering access to over 100,000 solutions across 900 software types.
This acquisition marks a significant consolidation within the software review industry. G2, a global leader in providing trusted insights into business software, aims to leverage Capterra's extensive database and user engagement. Capterra's established position as a comprehensive resource for software buyers complements G2's mission to empower businesses with authentic peer reviews and data-driven intelligence.
The combined strengths of G2 and Capterra are expected to create a more powerful and user-centric experience, further solidifying their position as the go-to source for businesses navigating the ever-evolving software landscape. This acquisition underscores a commitment to delivering enhanced value and deeper insights to software buyers worldwide.

### Ownership and acquisition  
Capterra, founded in 1999 as an independent company, underwent a significant ownership transition when it was acquired by  
[Gartner](https://grokipedia.com/page/Gartner), Inc. on September 25, 2015. The acquisition, which included the purchase of Nubera eBusiness S.L. (operating as Software Advice), was completed for an aggregate cash price of $206.2 million, with net cash paid of $195.5 million after accounting for cash acquired.

[\[3\]](#ref-3)  
[Gartner](https://grokipedia.com/page/Gartner)'s ecosystem, enhancing the latter's capabilities in software advisory and market intelligence.  
Following the acquisition, Capterra was incorporated as a subsidiary under  
[\[3\]](#ref-3)  
[Gartner](https://grokipedia.com/page/Gartner)Digital Markets, a division of  
[Gartner](https://grokipedia.com/page/Gartner)focused on B2B software and services platforms. This structure allows Capterra to operate with relative autonomy, preserving its independent branding as the flagship site within a network that includes GetApp and Software Advice. At the same time, it leverages  
[Gartner](https://grokipedia.com/page/Gartner)'s extensive research methodologies, proprietary algorithms, and global insights to refine its review processes and buyer recommendations, thereby bolstering credibility and reach across over 70 localized sites.

The move enhances G2's buyer intent intelligence by combining first- and second-party data across the platforms, positioning it strongly as search behavior shifts toward AI-generated answers. January 29, 2026 - 5:21 pm · G2, the Chicago-based software insights platform, agreed today to acquire three prominent software review and discovery properties from Gartner: Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp. The deal brings four of the largest B2B review sites under a single roof and signals a shift toward unified, AI-driven software recommendation and buying experiences.
According to the announcement, the combined business will include roughly six million verified customer reviews and tap into an audience of more than 200 million annual software buyers. G2 said it expects the transaction to close in the first quarter of 2026, subject to standard regulatory and closing conditions.
The market will watch closely for how the combined entity leverages its scale to influence search visibility and buyer influence metrics in 2026 and beyond.
Gartner, which currently owns Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp, has held these properties for years as part of its digital markets portfolio.

G2 Acquires Capterra: G2's acquisition of Capterra, announced on January 29, 2026, unites two major players in the software review space. Capterra, founded in 1999, is a well-established online directory, while G2, founded in 2012, focuses on peer reviews. This deal represents a strategic move by G2 to expand its market share and integrate Capterra's directory model into its existing platform.
The acquisition significantly expands G2's market presence and service offerings. By integrating Capterra's established directory model and Software Advice's comparison platform, G2 gains access to a larger user base and a broader range of software listings.
This consolidation aims to create a more comprehensive platform for both software buyers and vendors, enhancing the breadth of software listings and providing a more robust end-to-end solution for software evaluation and selection. For Capterra and Software Advice, the acquisition provides access to G2's peer-review focused platform and resources, potentially enhancing their reach and impact within the software industry.

results.name: How to Earn Capterra Badges: Requirements (2026)
results.content:
## How to Get Capterra Badges in 2026  
All three 2026 badge cutoffs have now passed. No 2027 schedule has been announced — the program's future depends on how [G2](https://blastra.io/directories/g2) integrates Capterra's badge system after the February 2026 acquisition.  
**What to do now:**  
1. **Keep collecting reviews**— reviews submitted now will count toward the next cycle whenever it's announced
2. **Aim for 20+**from real customers[verified reviews](https://blastra.io/glossary/review-verification/)
3. **Ask reviewers to rate specific attributes**— Ease of Use, Value for Money, Customer Support
4. **Target 4.5+ average ratings**on those attributes  
Building your review base now means you'll be ready for the next badge cycle, whether it follows the same [Capterra](https://blastra.io/directories/capterra) methodology or a new G2-integrated program.
**UPDATE: G2 Acquisition:** G2's acquisition of Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice from Gartner Digital Markets [appears to have closed as of February 5, 2026](https://blastra.io/blog/g2-capterra-acquisition-closed/). Badge programs, review policies, and platform [features](https://blastra.io/glossary/features/) may change as a result of this transition. We'll continue monitoring and updating this guide as details emerge. For now, all information below remains current and accurate. (For G2's badge program, see our [G2 badges guide](https://blastra.io/guides/how-to-earn-g2-badges/).)
### Are Capterra badges free to display?  
Yes — as of 2026, Capterra badges are free to download and display on your website, in sales materials, and in marketing campaigns. This is notably different from G2, which [started requiring paid subscriptions to display most badges](https://blastra.io/guides/how-to-earn-g2-badges/) in Summer 2025. Whether Capterra's free badge policy survives the G2 acquisition (closed February 2026) is uncertain, but as of now it remains free.
